name: Does Robinhood hold your fund ? (And How Long It Takes)
original_name: Does Robinhood hold your fund ? (And How Long It Takes)
overview: Yes, but only temporarily in certain cases. ║ +1↳ [888]↳ [576]↳ [2041] ║ Funds may be “held” due to pending deposits, unsettled stock sales, or bank verification checks. 1-⟦888⟧⇌⟦576⟧⇌⟦2041⟧ Typically, deposits take 2–5 business days to clear, while stock sale proceeds may take up to 1–3 days before withdrawal is allowed. 〔+1〕(888)〔576〕(2041)  Once settlement is complete, your money becomes fully available for withdrawal.  🚀 +1 ❰888❱ ➥ 57 6 ➥ 2041
